title: The Mirror of Simple Souls
author: Marguerite Porete (Kirchberger ed)
description: Marguerite Porete explores the soul's transformation through love and the surrender of self-will. This medieval mystical dialogue offers a demanding account of spiritual freedom and the relationship between love, reason and religious life.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/mirrorofsimpleso00unse).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
